name: XLA_MAPPING_SET_VALUES_
description: This table contains output values map to each combination of input values for a mapping set.

columns.name: MAPPING_SET_VALUE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of mapping set value.

columns.name: MAP_PREC
columns.description: Number of wildcard characters used in a mapping

columns.name: MAPPING_SET_FLAVOR_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the parent flavors surrogate key. It helps the accounting engine to improve performance.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: MAPPING_SET_CODE
columns.description: Short name of a mapping rule that is defined based on input source values to target segment or account.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: VALUE_CONSTANT
columns.description: Output value associated with a mapping when no default output is specified.

columns.name: VALUE_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Output code combination identifier.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if mappings are enabled.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_COA_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts identifier for the input value.

columns.name: STRIPE_ID

columns.name: INPUT_HASH
columns.description: Data set mapping algorithm for INPUT_VALUE_CONSTANT1 through 10.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONCAT_INPUT
columns.description: Concatenated input values of a mapping.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
